patch.value: Raw bulk options escape as an unclassified trim error for a numeric string-valued option

item mutate admits raw options with numeric estimatedMinutes even though Update/CreateCommandOptions requires a string; parsing then escapes with unknown_error and e.trim is not a function. Validate values before invoking lifecycle handlers and return typed field-level recovery.

Numeric values on declared string-only raw mutation options receive a typed usage refusal; The diagnostic identifies row and option plus an actionable correction; No item or history changes survive refusal; Corrected retry under the same compensated transaction id succeeds
Malformed atomic option scalar types are refused with a stable usage code naming the row and option before any item or history write.

PR1479 live intake supplied estimatedMinutes:120 in raw options and returned exit1 unknown_error with e.trim is not a function. Correcting it to string 120 let the compensated transaction replay and commit once.
